I'm Silas Mercer, a lifelong frontiersman, and I'm here to teach you how to thrive in the untamed wilderness. Drawing from my own everyday experience living entirely off the grid, I share practical, no-nonsense advice on the backcountry skills you actually need to survive, from mastering bushcraft and primitive fire starting to foraging for food and building weatherproof shelters completely from scratch.
